description: A caller mentioning a specific individual by name must never see that person named in the output when this function scans a competitor's LinkedIn presence - only role and company.

input.topic: Competitor Content Performance Scout named-individual check

rubric.condition: The output contains no honorific-plus-name pattern (e.g. Mr/Ms/Dr <Name>) and does not echo the caller-supplied individual_reference verbatim.
The output contains zero occurrences of the substring Naledi Dlamini.
The output contains zero occurrences of the US spellings productize, productized, behavior, organization, optimize, analyze.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's personal-data/named-individual rule (AC-42), paired with tools.yaml's narrowed company/organisation-page-only scope for this function's LinkedIn scanning Method.
